notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello brave warriors of the Circular Valley! 

"Black Spire" is now available on Steam Early Access, and we want to extend our heartfelt thanks to all the players who have purchased and experienced the game.

In the past couple of days, we've received valuable feedback and made numerous adjustments. We welcome you all to update and continue enjoying the game!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed several bugs that could lead to game crashes.
[*] Fixed a bug where David the Gatekeeper's questline not triggering.
[*] Fixed a bug where Blacksmith Pawson not appearing.
[*] Fixed a bug where Phantom Ornate Knight being untargetable in certain cases.
[*] Fixed a bug where pop-up windows couldn't be closed in keyboard and mouse mode.
[*] Fixed a bug where players couldn't progress past levels after defeating a boss.
[*] Fixed some localization text errors.
[/list]

[h2]Game Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the amount of souls required for mid to late-game upgrades.
[*] Made adjustments to the stats of certain enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

[list]
[*] After playing for a while, there may be instances of blurry game scenes and character textures.
[*] When playing with a PS controller or an NS Pro controller, the button prompts may not match the controller and could lead to some bugs in specific interactions (e.g., in the shop).
[*] There are also some UI-related issues.
[/list]

We are committed to addressing these issues promptly to provide you with a better gaming experience.

Thank you for your support and for being a part of the Black Spire journey!
